bio: First mentioned in records in 1137, the Erlhof can look back on a remarkably long history. Since 2002, the Brüggler family has been running this hotel and restaurant set in a beautiful location with a view of Lake Zell and the mountains – the terrace beckons in summer. In the kitchen, father-and-daughter team Josef and Sonja deliver classic cuisine and traditional regional fare with international influences, while mother-and-daughter front-of-house team Renate and Kathrin take good care of their guests. The warm, rustic-style interior complete with vaulted ceilings is inviting; one dining area has an open fireplace. In addition to cosy guestrooms, hotel patrons have private access to the lake just down from the hotel....
